system.summary: SynMod-4 is an engineered four-protein module: the inducer activates KinA, active KinA activates RegB, and active RegB converts the precursor PreC into ProD, which is lost slowly. The lab's own construction notes characterise each step in the module's strain.
system.scope: the module's own strain, as its construction notes document it, and one related synthetic module built from the same parts library
unknowns: whether anything besides RegB converts PreC
whether and where the product feeds back on the module
